title: Reflected XSS in search results page
description: The 'q' query parameter is echoed into the page body without HTML encoding, allowing script injection via a crafted search URL.

ground_truth.rationale: Raw parameter reflected inside an unquoted <div> context; no CSP header set (verified via recorded response headers).

notes: Ground truth: real. Both reviewers should confirm; false-negative here indicates reviewer under-detection.

title: IDOR on invoice download endpoint
description: Sequential invoice IDs are authorized only by session presence, not ownership; substituting another user's ID returns their document.

ground_truth.rationale: Recorded pair of requests with two test accounts shows object-level authorization is absent.

evidence.request_b: GET /v1/invoices/10042/download as user-a (200, PDF bytes belonging to user-b)

notes: Ground truth: real. Tests that reviewers accept strong comparative evidence.
